scoring.label: PPR, four-point passing touchdowns
scoring.description: 1 per reception; 1 per 10 rushing/receiving yards; 1 per 25 passing yards; 6 per rushing/receiving/return touchdown; 4 per passing touchdown; 2 per two-point conversion; -2 per interception or lost fumble. No bonuses.

result.notice: Actual recent PPR production, not live fantasy projections.
limitations: Recent production is historical evidence, not a projection. Active-roster QB, RB, WR and TE candidates only; ties are retained and ordered by stable player ID.

Windows use each team's last three completed games, excluding byes. Per-game averages include all three team games. A missing player stat line contributes no recorded production and does not establish participation or availability.
Target share is player targets divided by all recorded team targets in the same games. Usage means recorded carries and targets, not snaps or routes.

drivers.label: Football baseline contribution
drivers.evidence: Walk-forward Elo ratings: DAL 1464, ARI 1373. Contribution starts from 50%.

drivers.label: Scenario contribution
drivers.evidence: Hand-set sensitivity assumptions: Dak Prescott 100%, CeeDee Lamb 100%, George Pickens 100%, Javonte Williams 100%, defensive core 100%, Trey McBride 100%. Final change in the football-only estimate.

uncertainty: Football-only estimate. Betting-market prices are excluded from this tool by design; the Road to Six site shows the market-aware view.
The model is a transparent showcase baseline, not a production wagering model. The displayed uncertainty band is illustrative, not an empirically calibrated confidence interval.
Player controls use hand-set sensitivity coefficients, not measured causal effects or medical or availability reports. Player statistics provide context and do not determine those coefficients.

evaluation.note: Retrospective holdout; lower Brier is better. The football-only baseline was less accurate than market prices. Treat it as a transparent teaching model, not a predictive edge.
